### EIP712TypedData {#EIP712TypedData}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">EIP712TypedData</code></div>

EIP-712 typed data as viem and `eth_signTypedData_v4` take it, loose
enough for eth-sig-util's `TypedMessage` (a `salt` as bytes, a string
`verifyingContract`, a `keyof` `primaryType`). An `EIP712Domain` entry in
`types` is accepted (and must match `domain`).

```ts sdk-signature
interface EIP712TypedData {
  domain?: {
    name?: string;
    version?: string;
    chainId?: number | bigint;
    verifyingContract?: string;
    salt?: string | ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView;
  };
  types: Record<
    string,
    ReadonlyArray<{
      name: string;
      type: string;
    }>
  >;
  primaryType: string | number;
  message: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>domain?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">{ name?: string; version?: string; chainId?: number &#124; bigint; verifyingContract?: string; salt?: string &#124; ArrayBuffer &#124; ArrayBufferView; }</span> |  |
| <code>types</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Record&lt;string, ReadonlyArray&lt;{ name: string; type: string }&gt;&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>primaryType</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string &#124; number</span> | A number (from a `keyof` type) is read as its string form. |
| <code>message</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;</span> |  |

</div>

### PublicClients {#PublicClients}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">type</span> <code class="sdk-qual">PublicClients</code></div>

Public clients for contract-wallet (EIP-1271) signature checks: one per
chain id, or a function that returns the client for a chain id (or
undefined). Each client must be on the chain it is given for; one on
another chain is ignored.

```ts sdk-signature
type PublicClients =
  | Record<number, PublicClient>
  | ((chainId: number) => PublicClient | undefined);
```

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/cluster/eip712.ts#L135">source</a></p>

### BlsBackend {#BlsBackend}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">BlsBackend</code></div>

BLS12-381 (Ethereum consensus: G1 public keys, G2 signatures, POP
ciphersuite) operations used by [`cluster.verifyLock`](../cluster.md#verifyLock) and
[`deposits.assertDepositData`](../deposits.md#assertDepositData). `PublicKey` is the backend's decoded G1
point; the SDK only passes values it got from `decodePublicKey` or
`aggregatePublicKeys` back in.

For Node servers the SDK ships an adapter over `@chainsafe/blst` (native,
an optional peer dependency) in a separate entry, so no other entry and no
browser bundle refers to it:

```ts
import { isValidLock } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';
import { loadBlstBackend } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk/blst';

const bls = await loadBlstBackend(); // or blstBackendFrom(await import('@chainsafe/blst'))
const ok = await isValidLock(lock, { bls });
```

```ts sdk-signature
interface BlsBackend<PublicKey = unknown> {
  decodePublicKey(
    bytes: Uint8Array,
    subgroupCheck: boolean,
  ): PublicKey;
  aggregatePublicKeys(keys: PublicKey[]): PublicKey;
  onPolynomial(
    points: PublicKey[],
    threshold: number,
  ): boolean;
  verify(
    publicKey: PublicKey,
    message: Uint8Array,
    signature: Uint8Array,
  ): boolean;
  createBatch(): BlsBatch<PublicKey>;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>decodePublicKey</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicKey</span> | Decodes a compressed G1 point. Throws for a malformed encoding, a point not on the curve, and the identity. With `subgroupCheck`, also for a point outside the prime-order subgroup; without it the backend may skip that check (the SDK asks for it only where the result is implied by other checks), and checking anyway is always correct. |
| <code>aggregatePublicKeys</code> | <span class="sdk-type">PublicKey</span> | The sum of the keys (may be the identity). |
| <code>onPolynomial</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> | Whether `points[x]`, for x = 0..n, are the values of one polynomial of degree below `threshold`: every `threshold`-th forward difference is the identity. Must use exact curve arithmetic: the points need not be in the subgroup. |
| <code>verify</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> | Verifies one signature; false (not a throw) for a malformed signature. |
| <code>createBatch</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="#BlsBatch">BlsBatch</a>&lt;PublicKey&gt;</span> | A new, empty signature batch. |

</div>

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/cluster/blsBackend.ts#L58">source</a></p>

### BlsBatch {#BlsBatch}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">BlsBatch</code></div>

A batch of signatures that is valid only if every signature in it is
valid on its own.

```ts sdk-signature
interface BlsBatch<PublicKey = unknown> {
  add(
    publicKey: PublicKey,
    message: Uint8Array,
    signature: Uint8Array,
  ): void;
  verify(): boolean;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>add</code> | <span class="sdk-type">void</span> | Adds one signature. Throws if `signature` is not a valid compressed G2 point in the prime-order subgroup, or is the identity. |
| <code>verify</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> | True only if every added signature verifies on its own. A batch that is checked as one equation must weight each signature with fresh secret random scalars of at least 64 bits (a plain sum accepts invalid signatures that cancel out). |

</div>

<p class="sdk-see"><a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/cluster/blsBackend.ts#L24">source</a></p>
